class.name: VECSSyncStrategy
class.brief_description:
Pluggable replication strategy used by [VECSNetworkSync].
由 [VECSNetworkSync] 使用的可插拔复制策略。
class.description:
[b]VECSSyncStrategy[/b] is the abstraction a [VECSNetworkSync] uses to replicate world state. Subclass it to implement a custom strategy (deterministic lockstep, event-only sync, ...); assign it with [method VECSNetworkSync.set_strategy].
The default implementation is [VECSSnapshotReplication] (server-authoritative dirty-checking + reconciliation).
[b]VECSSyncStrategy[/b] 是 [VECSNetworkSync] 用于复制世界状态的抽象。继承它实现自定义策略（确定性锁定步进、仅事件同步等）；用 [method VECSNetworkSync.set_strategy] 赋值。
默认实现是 [VECSSnapshotReplication]（服务器权威脏检查 + 对账）。
